Two-Stage Bootstrap Approximation for an N-Mixture Model

Source: R/nmix.R
ijk_bootstrap_2stage.Rd

Generates bootstrap replicates of a posterior mean from a single MCMC run, using the first-order (infinitesimal jackknife) approximation with site-level and visit-level weights: $$\theta^{(b)} \approx E[\theta] + \sum_i (u_{bi} - 1) c_i + \sum_{i,j} (v_{bij} - 1) e_{ij}.$$

Usage

ijk_bootstrap_2stage(
  object,
  B = 1000,
  type = c("twostage", "site", "visit"),
  weights = NULL,
  latent_resid = NULL
)

Arguments

object

An object of class "ijk_nmix".

B

Positive integer giving the number of bootstrap replicates when weights is NULL; ignored when weights is supplied.

type

One of "twostage", "site", "visit".

weights

Optional weights from nmix_weights(), to share the same resamples across quantities.

latent_resid

Optional finite numeric vector (length \(S\)) or finite numeric matrix with \(S\) rows and \(K\) columns, containing latent prediction errors; one randomly chosen draw is added to each replicate.

Value

An object of class c("ijk_boot_nmix", "ijk_boot") with estimate, replicates (vector of length \(B\), or \(B \times K\) matrix), B and type.

Details

"twostage"

Sites and, within them, visits are resampled (see nmix_weights()).

"site"

Only sites are resampled (\(v = 1\)); equivalent to ijk_bootstrap() with the site-level influence.

"visit"

Sites are kept (\(u = 1\)) and only visits are resampled within each site.

For a quantity that involves the latent abundance itself, such as the realised total \(\sum_i N_i\), the likelihood-based replicates only capture the variation through the parameters. Pass latent_resid (see nmix_latent_resid()) to add the prediction error of the latent variables.

See also

nmix_loglik(), ijk_nmix(), nmix_weights()

Examples

set.seed(1)
I <- 10; J <- 3; S <- 200
y <- matrix(rpois(I * J, 3), I, J)
lambda <- matrix(rgamma(S * I, 20, 4), S, I)
p <- matrix(runif(S * I * J, 0.4, 0.7), S, I * J)
ll <- nmix_loglik(y, lambda, p)
fit <- ijk_nmix(rowSums(lambda), ll)
boot <- ijk_bootstrap_2stage(fit, B = 500)
summary(boot)
#>   estimate        bias       se  lower    upper
#> 1 49.89695 -0.06030114 1.182523 47.621 52.15243
